question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cognitive
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cognitive"** refers to mental processes related to knowledge, understanding, and thinking. (संज्ञानात्मक)

 
 
• **Example:** **Cognitive** development in children is crucial for their ability to learn and solve problems.
 
 
 
• **"Perceivable"** means something that can be seen, noticed, or understood. (प्रत्यक्ष)
 
 
• **Example:** There was a **perceivable **improvement in her health after she started the new medication.
 
 

Hence, the synonym of **'Cognitive'** is **'Perceivable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Latent** (गुप्त): Present but not visible, apparent, or actualized; existing as potential.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a** latent** talent for painting that she has yet to explore.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not clear or hard to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so **obscure** that no one could follow them.
 
 
 
• **Private** (निजी): Belonging to or for the use of one particular person or group; not public.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a **private **office where he can work without interruptions.
